map=campus-martius&scenario=assault.note: Rome's assault, re-recorded at the wall-file pass (a unit on a wall is a file the wall's depth). The garrison's *initial* layout changes, which is why t+0 moves at all: layOutOnWall spreads a garrison along its run at the band's depth instead of heaping it into the largest unclaimed gap, so every defender starts on a different stone. Attrition moves with it -- alive at t+200 2186 -> 2099, 87 more dead across 3074 -- because a garrison that actually mans its parapet is a garrison that can be shot at. That is a consequence of the fix and not a lever anyone chose; it is called out in the report for the owner. The field battle ('default') is bit-identical across the same change, which is the check that says this is confined to the wall. Re-record only in the same commit as the change that moved it.

map=carthage&scenario=assault.note: Carthage's assault, re-recorded at the wall-file pass for the same reason as the Rome entry above -- see it. Alive at t+200 2851 -> 2773. Re-record only in the same commit as the change that moved it.
